facts.value: You come from abroad to us? Discover the diverse offerings for foreign students and researchers at Goethe University and shape your personal academic path.

With Goethe into the world: Whether studying abroad, ERASMUS study, internship, or work in research and teaching – a stay abroad opens up many new opportunities and perspectives for your personal and professional development.
Internationality shapes our research, our programs, and our campus. In this respect, all members of Goethe University are international – regardless of their background.
